```artifact
Feature: Doctor Consultation and Prescription Management

  Scenario: Doctor views pending appointments and provides consultation
    Given the doctor is logged into the system
    When the doctor accesses the pending appointments list
    Then the doctor can see a list of pending appointments/consultation requests
    And the doctor can select an appointment to provide consultation

  Scenario: Doctor provides consultation and generates a prescription
    Given the doctor is providing consultation to a patient
    When the doctor completes the consultation
    Then a prescription is generated for the patient

  Scenario Outline: Doctor prescribes lab tests during consultation
    Given the doctor is providing consultation to a patient
    When the doctor prescribes a lab test with name <test_name>
    Then a lab test request is created for the patient
    And the lab is requested to perform the lab test
    Examples:
      | test_name       |
      | Blood Test      |
      | Urine Test      |
      | Invalid Test    |

  Scenario Outline: Doctor prescribes medicines during consultation
    Given the doctor is providing consultation to a patient
    When the doctor prescribes a medicine with name <medicine_name>
    Then a medicine request is created for the patient
    And the concerned chemist is requested to deliver the medicine
    Examples:
      | medicine_name   |
      | Paracetamol     |
      | Aspirin         |
      | Invalid Medicine|

  Scenario: Lab tests are performed and reports are updated (Offline)
    Given the lab has received a request for a lab test
    When the lab performs the test
    Then the lab report for the patient is updated (Offline)

  Scenario: Lab report is released to view (Offline)
    Given the lab report for the patient is updated (Offline)
    When the doctor accesses the patient's lab reports
    Then the doctor can view the lab report (Offline)
```
